statement.zh: 考古研究将诺克表述为尼日利亚中部以特色陶俑与早期铁器为标志的考古文化（Fagg 识别传统；近年 JAA 年代学）。
statement.en: Research frames Nok as a central Nigerian archaeological culture marked by distinctive terracottas and early iron (Fagg identification tradition; recent JAA chronologies).
